name: sensitive-query-redacted-referrer
description: Default referrerFormat 'url' removes sensitive query keys (sid, user_email) from the stored external referrer and the email from the landing page, keeping the search query; the channel is still classified from the raw referrer.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT FIX (#83, plugin parity click-trail-handler#232): sensitive query keys never reach ft_/lt_referrer. Semver: behavior change on a default; recorded in specs/003-sensitive-query-redaction. CLASSIFIER_VERSION and SCHEMA_VERSION unchanged.
